items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: guys like – what’s his name? Jason – Jackson Pollack – are frauds.

ctx.x: Yeah. I still love painting better than anything. I like the Old Masters, though. I don’t really gravitate to modern art. I think a lot of it is chicanery and just b.s. I think it’s people who can’t learn to draw and paint classically, creating a place for themselves. It’s like the avant garde in jazz. They can’t play the blues, so they’re going to make not playing the blues fashionable, and they can’t swing, so they’re going to make that fashionable.
